name: Fawwaz ibn Jurays al-Dawsari
bio: A contemporary author of works on legal reasoning, logic and the life of Muhammad. He signed the introduction to A Necklace of Meanings in April 2025 (1446 AH). That August (1447 AH) he signed Al-Gharra, his verse account of the Prophet’s expeditions. He also wrote a study of logical fallacies illustrated with everyday and legal examples.
